_comment: Not a Claude Code/Kilo-native manifest - neither tool's plugin installer reads or enforces this. Same convention as skill-requirements.json: a separate, self-consistent file our own scripts can check, kept out of plugin.json to avoid depending on whether that schema tolerates unknown keys. The ai-orchestration entry is already checked for real by scripts/regenerate_bound_skills.py (degrades to a warning, not a failure, when that checkout isn't found); the task-pipeline entry also lives in ai-orchestration.

dependencies.reason: kilo-mcp-orchestrator, kilo-mcp-metrics-analyst, and kilo-mcp-conflict-resolver are generated from that repo's SKILL.template.md sources plus this repo's own bindings/*.json - see scripts/regenerate_bound_skills.py.

kilo-mcp-orchestrator and kilo-mcp-orchestrator-agent reference the tasks/ tree convention (CONTEXT.md, 00-INDEX.md, specs/, NN-<slug>/plan.md, summary.md) that skill owns - inherited from ai-orchestration's generic template and referenced directly in kilo-mcp-orchestrator-agent.md's bookkeeping step.
